title: SG-4.2.2 Untrack node_modules files in game/frontend with tested cleanup code
summary: Provide code that untracks the ~15,000 tracked node_modules files without deleting them from disk, plus mocked unit tests that guard against tracked dependency paths.
description: Context: about 15,327 files under game/frontend/node_modules (Phaser, type-generation tests, .vite/vitest/results.json) are tracked by git. Desired behavior: a helper in game/frontend/src/lib lists tracked node_modules paths, a cleanup untracks them with git rm -r --cached, and unit tests with mocked git fail while any such path is tracked. Why: dependency files must not be versioned.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of paths, when trackedNodeModulesPaths runs, then it returns only paths with a node_modules segment.
Given a fake git runner, when untrackNodeModules runs, then it issues 'git rm -r --cached' for node_modules and never deletes files from disk.
Given a mocked file listing with a node_modules path, when the guard runs, then it throws; given none, it passes.
definition_of_done: All three requirements delivered with passing unit tests
